content.text: The paper, "R: A Language for Data Analysis and Graphics," published in 1996 by Ross Ihaka and Robert Gentleman, is the focus. The section requires calculations of mean absolute error and mean squared error based on residuals. The task involves deriving the residual after a correction for given observations.

The section will be named "Methods". The calculation of mean absolute error and mean squared error uses base R, distinct from the figure generation with R/ggplot2. Downstream artifacts like .R and .tex figure sources, PDFs, and manuscript previews will be preserved for reproducibility. The discussion focuses on finite arithmetic, avoiding a separate theoretical proof.
